title: Plant Manager
text:
**Plant Manager**
=================

**Company:** North Point Technology Consulting 
**Work Location:** Fort Wayne, Indiana, USA 
**Employment Type:** Full-Time / Contract 
**Work Arrangement:** On-Site

### **Job Overview**

North Point Technology Consulting is seeking an experienced Plant Manager to lead a high-volume automotive driveline manufacturing plant in Fort Wayne, Indiana.

This leader owns the full plant P&L and organizes, leads, and manages every functional area of the facility, driving lean manufacturing and a Toyota Production System based operating system while building a motivated, high-performing workforce.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own the full plant P&L, including strategy, policies, processes, and systems.
* Lead manufacturing and assembly operations, finance (budget, cost control, capital), supply chain and inventory, EHS, labor relations, and engineering and facilities.
* Drive lean manufacturing and continuous improvement in cost, quality, productivity, and operational excellence.
* Lead metrics and reporting, program management, and product launches.
* Build and develop a motivated workforce that meets or exceeds performance standards.
* Communicate effectively at all levels and with customers, suppliers, and the community.
* Influence business unit and executive leadership on strategy and long-range improvement plans.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or 4+ years of applicable experience, with 12+ years of manufacturing experience.
* Experience working in a unionized environment.
* Proven ability to set and execute long-term operational strategy tied to efficiency, cost, and quality.
* Deep understanding of manufacturing systems, lean principles, and continuous improvement.
* Strong budgeting, cost analysis, and financial metrics skills.
* Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop diverse teams with a focus on safety and accountability.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior plant manager or operations director experience in automotive or heavy manufacturing.

### **About North Point Technology Consulting**

North Point Technology Consulting provides specialized engineering and technology professionals to support manufacturing automation, MES implementations, ERP systems, and industrial technology operations across the United States and internationally.

North Point Technology is **THE BEST** place to work for curious-minded engineers motivated to support our country's most crucial missions! We focus on long term projects, leveraging the latest technology in support of innovative solutions to solve our customer's most difficult problems.

At North Point Technology, EMPLOYEES come first! We value our employees by providing excellent compensation, benefits, and a flexible work-life balance. We strive for a close-knit and open atmosphere where the owners are always directly available to our team members.

**Come join us!** **Apply with North Point Technology today!**

*For positions requiring a federal security clearance, your clearance level must be clearly identified on your resume.*
